verses.text: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
“Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.
Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.
Do everything in love.
For we walk by faith, not by sight.
Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
We love because He first loved us.
The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.
The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God stands forever.
You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.
I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.
The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.
For no word from God will ever fail.
For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!
Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.
Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
Rejoice at all times.
Pray without ceasing.
Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
